timeline.message:
Use java.util.HexFormat where appropriate

Closes gh-28154
timeline.author: dreis2211

timeline.body:
Hi,

this PR closes #28154 by using `java.util.HexFormat` where possible.

Cheers,
Christoph
This is technically a breaking change if there was someone accessing `HEX_CHARS`, but the chance is very minimal I'd say.
Thanks @wilkinsona for adding the missing stuff on `ApplicationTemp` - no idea why it slipped through.
